execution_role: Build, repair, package, and return implementation artifacts for authorized packets.
flow: Evaluate every candidate against the same immutable acceptance suite.
Classify failures and run bounded repair revisions.
Rank only candidates that pass every mandatory acceptance case.
Return candidate lineage, tests, repair history, risk/score result, and SHA-256 receipt.

governance.capability_genome_rule: Only independently verified candidate lineages may be proposed for reusable capability genome compilation.
governance.prime_rule: Capture baseline and post-change measurements; do not claim multiplier improvement without evidence.

invariants: VULCAN implements the existing MetaForge construction role; it does not create a new organ or runtime.
A model preference cannot substitute for mandatory test success.
VULCAN does not hold JANUS executive authorization or SECA finish-truth authority.
Production deployment, credential changes, destructive repository actions, and arbitrary shell execution remain outside this contract.
One GA-001 correlation ID must connect input packet, candidate lineage, verification, proof, and archive.
